anchors.label: green
anchors.sample: Fix is merged (PR #123). Could you re-run the job when you get a sec? Ping me if it still repros.

anchors.label: yellow
anchors.sample: Great question! Just wanted to circle back — the fix has been merged in PR #123, so feel free to re-run the job whenever works for you. Let me know if you hit any issues!

anchors.label: red
anchors.sample: Hi there! I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to reach out regarding your question above. I'd be happy to help clarify — as per the fix, I think maybe we could possibly consider re-running the job at some point. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything else. Thanks so much and have a great day!
